Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is included in the
Aarogyam Comprehensive Prime
package by Thyrocare?
This Thyrocare package includes
65 tests
covering diabetes (HbA1c), liver and kidney function, cholesterol levels, thyroid (TSH), iron profile, and a complete blood count (CBC).
2. Why choose Thyrocare for this test?
Thyrocare is India’s trusted diagnostic brand with
NABL, CAP, and ISO certifications
, known for precise reports, fast delivery, and affordable full-body checkups.
3. Is fasting mandatory for this package?
Yes. A
10 to 12 hour fasting period
(water only) is essential for accurate results, particularly for lipid, glucose, and iron parameters.
4. Who should take the
Aarogyam Comprehensive Prime
checkup?
This is suitable for adults aiming to monitor vital health markers annually or check for early signs of lifestyle-related conditions like high cholesterol, anemia, or thyroid imbalance.
5. What is the home collection process like?
Thyrocare arranges
free sample collection
at your doorstep. A trained technician collects your blood sample quickly and safely without needing to visit a lab.
6. How soon will I get the report?
You’ll receive a full digital report via email or WhatsApp within
24 to 48 hours
after sample collection.
7. Is this package enough for annual health screening?
Yes. Aarogyam Prime by Thyrocare provides a balanced diagnostic view for annual wellness monitoring—covering all essential health indicators in one go.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is included in the Aarogyam 1+1 Dual Offer by Thyrocare?
Thyrocare’s Aarogyam 1+1 Dual Offer includes
two complete health checkups
under one package. Each profile covers
60+ parameters
, including
thyroid, liver, kidney, diabetes, iron, lipid profile, vitamins, and CBC
, ideal for couples, families, or friends.
2. Who should book the Aarogyam 1+1 package?
This package is perfect for
two individuals
who want to undergo a
comprehensive health screening
together at an affordable cost—ideal for couples, parents, or siblings.
3. What makes this a dual offer?
With the 1+1 offer, you pay for
one package
and get the
same tests for another person
at no extra cost, effectively cutting down the price per person by 50%.
4. Is fasting required for this test?
Yes,
10–12 hours of overnight fasting
is required for accurate blood sugar, lipid profile, and metabolic parameter results. Only water is allowed during fasting.
5. What samples are collected in this package?
A
blood sample
and
urine sample
are collected from both individuals to complete the full test panel.
6. How will the test reports be delivered?
Reports for both individuals will be delivered within
24 to 48 hours
via email or can be accessed online through Thyrocare’s secure report portal.
7. Are the tests reliable and conducted in certified labs?
Yes, all tests under Thyrocare are performed in
NABL and CAP-accredited laboratories
, ensuring high accuracy and clinical reliability.
8. Can I schedule home sample collection for both people together?
Absolutely. Thyrocare provides
free home sample collection
for both individuals at the same time and location, offering maximum convenience.
9. Can I book this test in different cities for two people?
Generally, the dual offer is applicable for
same-location bookings
. For different locations, please check with the Thyrocare customer support before booking.
10. How often should I take the Aarogyam 1+1 health checkup?
It is recommended to take this comprehensive health checkup
once a year
, or more frequently if advised by your healthcare provider based on health conditions.

1. What tests are included in the Thyrocare Aarogyam XL Plus Profile with UTSH package?
The Thyrocare Aarogyam XL Plus Profile with UTSH is one of the most advanced preventive health check-up packages offered by Thyrocare. It comprises
163
parameters
including ultra-sensitive TSH, thyroid hormones (T3, T4), CBC, liver tests, fasting and post-prandial blood glucose, HbA1c, lipid profile, cardiac risk markers (hs-CRP, Apo A1, Apo B, Lipoprotein A, Homocysteine), iron studies, mineral profile, hormone panel, pancreatic enzymes, arthritis screening, toxic element testing, and urine routine.
2. Who should opt for the Thyrocare Aarogyam XL Plus Profile with UTSH package?
This health package is recommended for individuals who are looking for a
complete and thorough body check-up
. It is ideal for people above 30 years of age, those with sedentary lifestyles, or a family history of heart disease, diabetes, thyroid disorders, or metabolic issues.
3. Is fasting required before taking this Thyrocare test?
Yes, fasting for
10 to 12 hours
is required before sample collection. Only water should be consumed during this time. Fasting ensures the most accurate results for blood sugar, lipid, and liver function tests.

Thyrocare provides
free home sample collection
through professionally trained phlebotomists. Blood and urine samples are collected at your doorstep and processed in Thyrocare’s
NABL-certified, fully automated laboratories
, ensuring precise and timely results.
5. What is the cost of the Thyrocare Aarogyam XL Plus Profile with UTSH package?
The Thyrocare Aarogyam XL Plus Profile with UTSH is generally priced at Rs 6649. The package includes 163+ tests and free home collection, offering excellent value for a full-body preventive screening.
6. When will I receive my Thyrocare test reports?
Reports are usually delivered within
24 to 48 hours
from the time of sample collection. Thyrocare ensures digital delivery of reports through email or SMS for easy and quick access.
7. Is the Thyrocare Aarogyam XL Plus Profile with UTSH package available across India?
Yes, Thyrocare offers this package
pan India
, with a wide logistics and phlebotomy network. Home collection services are available in most urban and semi-urban areas.
8. What makes the Thyrocare Aarogyam XL Plus Profile with UTSH unique?
This package offers one of the
most comprehensive preventive health screenings
in India. It covers all major body systems including cardiovascular, endocrine, hepatic, renal, nutritional, and toxicology parameters. With tests processed in Thyrocare’s high-end, automated labs, you get accurate, insightful reports to take control of your health.

It is an advanced preventive health package that combines

It is recommended for individuals with
long-standing allergies, asthma, skin reactions
, hormonal imbalance, lifestyle disorders, or those who want the most detailed preventive screening.
3. How does the allergy screening work in this package?
The
Phadiatop Adult test
screens for sensitivity to common inhalant and environmental allergens, helping detect allergy even when the exact trigger is unknown.
4. What makes Aarogyam XL different from Aarogyam X?
Aarogyam XL includes
additional steroid hormone testing and expanded hematology parameters
, offering deeper insight into hormonal balance and stress-related conditions.
5. What health areas are covered in this package?
It covers
allergy screening, arthritis markers, cardiac risk markers, CBC, diabetes, electrolytes, iron deficiency, lipid profile, liver, kidney, thyroid, pancreatic function, metabolic markers, steroid hormones, vitamins, toxic elements, and urine analysis
.
6. Can this package help in managing chronic allergy and asthma?
Yes, allergy screening combined with inflammatory, hormonal, and metabolic markers supports better diagnosis and long-term management of
allergy-related and respiratory conditions
.
7. Is fasting required for this package?
Yes,
10–12 hours fasting
is recommended for accurate assessment of diabetes, lipid profile, and metabolic parameters.
8. How is the sample collected?

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the
Thyrocare
AAROGYAM D PRO Package?
The AAROGYAM D PRO Package is a comprehensive preventive health checkup that evaluates your overall health by assessing blood sugar, cholesterol, liver function, kidney function, thyroid function, complete blood count, Vitamin D levels, and several other essential health parameters. It helps in the early detection of lifestyle diseases and nutritional deficiencies.
2. Who should take the
Thyrocare
AAROGYAM D PRO Package?
This package is recommended for adults above 30 years of age, people with a family history of diabetes or heart disease, individuals with obesity, high blood pressure, fatigue, Vitamin D deficiency, thyroid disorders, or anyone looking for a comprehensive annual health checkup.
3. Why is Vitamin D included in this package?
Vitamin D is essential for strong bones, healthy muscles, immunity, and overall well-being. Low Vitamin D levels are common and may lead to fatigue, muscle weakness, bone pain, and reduced immunity. Including Vitamin D screening helps identify deficiencies early and supports timely treatment.
4. Is fasting required before the
Thyrocare
AAROGYAM D PRO Package?
Yes. A fasting period of
10–12 hours
is generally recommended for accurate blood sugar and lipid profile results. You may drink plain water during the fasting period unless your doctor advises otherwise.
5. Can the
Thyrocare
AAROGYAM D PRO Package detect diabetes?
Yes. The package includes blood sugar tests that help identify diabetes, prediabetes, and monitor blood glucose control. It also evaluates other organs that may be affected by long-term diabetes, such as the kidneys and heart.
6. Does this package include kidney and liver function tests?
Yes. The package includes kidney function tests and liver function tests to assess the health and performance of these vital organs. Early detection of abnormalities can help prevent serious complications.
7. Is the
Thyrocare
AAROGYAM D PRO Package suitable for healthy individuals?
Yes. Even if you do not have symptoms, this package is ideal for routine preventive health screening. Many conditions such as diabetes, high cholesterol, thyroid disorders, and Vitamin D deficiency may not show symptoms in their early stages.
8. How often should I take the
Thyrocare
AAROGYAM D PRO Package?
For most adults, an annual health checkup is recommended. Individuals with diabetes, hypertension, obesity, thyroid disorders, or other chronic conditions may need more frequent testing based on their doctors recommendation.
9. What should I do if my test results are abnormal?
Abnormal results do not always indicate a serious medical condition. Your doctor will interpret the results along with your symptoms, medical history, medications, and physical examination before recommending further tests or treatment.
10. Can I book the Thyrocare AAROGYAM D PRO Package with home sample collection?
Yes. The
Thyrocare
AAROGYAM D PRO Package can be booked online with convenient home sample collection in serviceable locations, allowing you to get tested without visiting a diagnostic centre.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the Aarogyam Tax Saver Advanced package by Thyrocare?
Thyrocare’s Aarogyam Tax Saver Advanced is a
comprehensive preventive health checkup
designed to monitor overall wellness and help you save on medical expenses under
Section 80D of the Income Tax Act
. It includes
100+ test parameters
covering thyroid profile, diabetes, lipid profile, liver and kidney function, cardiac risk markers, vitamins, iron studies, and complete blood count (CBC).
2. How does this package help in tax saving?
By undergoing the Aarogyam Tax Saver Advanced health checkup, you can claim
tax deductions on preventive health checkup expenses
under
Section 80D
, reducing your overall taxable income.
3. Who should opt for this package?
It is ideal for
working professionals, families, and senior citizens
who want to stay proactive about their health while enjoying the benefit of tax savings.
4. Is fasting required before taking this test?
Yes,
10–12 hours of fasting
is recommended for accurate results, especially for blood sugar, lipid profile, and certain metabolic parameters.
5. What samples are collected in this package?
Both
blood and urine samples
are collected for a complete health evaluation.
6. How soon will I get my results from Thyrocare?
Reports are generally delivered within
24 to 48 hours
and are available online or via email.
7. Are the results accurate and accepted by doctors?
Yes, all tests are conducted in
NABL and CAP-accredited Thyrocare laboratories
, ensuring high accuracy and clinical reliability.
8. Can I book this package for home sample collection?
Yes, Thyrocare provides
free home sample collection
, making the process convenient for individuals with busy schedules.
9. How often should I book the Aarogyam Tax Saver Advanced package?
It’s recommended to take this package
once a year
to monitor your health and also claim annual preventive health checkup tax benefits.
10. Can my family members also use this package?
Yes, the package can be booked for individual family members, and each eligible expense can be claimed for
tax deduction
as per IT rules.
